about.heroTitle:
Rooted in Passion,
Grown with Purpose
about.heroSubtitle: Juniper Ridge Landscape is a sole-practitioner design studio specializing in landscape and hardscape design for residential properties throughout the Wasatch Front, Utah.

story.title: My Story
story.p1: Juniper Ridge Landscape was built on a simple belief: every outdoor space has the potential to become something extraordinary. I started this studio to offer homeowners throughout the Wasatch Front a thoughtful, personal approach to landscape and hardscape design.
story.p2: I spent years studying horticulture and design before establishing Juniper Ridge, bringing a blend of technical knowledge and artistic vision to every project. I believe great landscape design isn't just about aesthetics — it's about creating spaces that enhance how you live and suit the unique character of Utah's environment.
story.p3: As a one-person studio, I'm involved in every project from the very first site visit through the final set of construction drawings. You'll always work directly with me.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: We design with nature in mind, using native plants, water-wise practices, and eco-friendly materials.

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.description: Every detail matters. We take pride in precision, quality materials, and meticulous execution.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Your vision drives our design. We listen deeply and work with you every step of the way.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: We stay ahead of design trends and horticultural science to bring fresh ideas to your landscape.

team.title: Meet the Designer
team.subtitle: A solo practice dedicated to thoughtful, personal landscape and hardscape design.

founder.name: Sarah Mitchell
founder.bio: With a degree in Landscape Architecture and a background in Utah horticulture, Sarah brings deep knowledge of Wasatch Front conditions — soil, climate, water use, and native plants — to every project.
